section_summary: This section of decimal file 894.012 covers correspondence and official documentation from June to December 1945 concerning Japanese passports, nationality laws, and procedures for the recovery of citizenship. It includes communications from the Consulate General in Manila transmitting seized Japanese passports to the State Department and FBI, alongside inquiries between the State Department and the U.S. Political Adviser in Tokyo regarding rumored post-1924 Japanese nationality legislation. The bulk of the section consists of Tokyo Despatch No. 95 enclosing an extensive June 1944 Japanese Ministry of Home Affairs booklet compiling instructions, imperial ordinances, and statutory provisions on nationality recovery dating back to the Nationality Act of 1899.

subfiles.summary: Despatch from the Acting Political Adviser in Tokyo enclosing a June 1944 Japanese Ministry of Home Affairs booklet titled 'Data Relating to the Recovery of Japanese Nationality' (Kokuseki Kaifuku ni Kansuru Shiryo). The enclosed compilation sets forth administrative instructions, imperial ordinances, and statutory texts issued since the Nationality Act of 1899 governing the recovery, acquisition, and loss of Japanese nationality. It includes detailed application forms, procedural regulations, and legal precedents particularly affecting individuals of Japanese descent living in overseas areas and wartime occupied territories.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 95: Japanese Nationality Laws, Transmitting Booklet 'Data Relating to the Recovery of Japanese Nationality'
